## MID-TERM PROJECT OF R-PROGRAMMING

### Installation and calling the packages for loading data

```{r inst, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("readxl","readr"))
```

```{r packages}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
```

### Loading CO2 Emmission & Population data

```{r load-co2}
co2_emmission <- read_csv("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/CO2_emission.csv")
```

```{r load-pop}
world_pop <- read_csv("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/world_population.csv")
```

### Checking & dropping duplicates rows
```{r}
sum(duplicated(world_pop))

```

## New variable creation based on existing variable

### To create new variable from existing when you are given initial population population (base of 2020 population size) growth rate(differ to each & every country),natural logarithm (2.71828) and time period(8 years.

```{r Pop in 2030}
time<- 2030-2022
world_pop$Pop_2030 <- world_pop$`2022 Population` *exp((world_pop$`Growth Rate` - 1) * 8)
```

## Extracting top ten countries with largest number of population

```{r top ten countries}
top_ten<-world_pop[order(world_pop$`2020 Population`,decreasing = TRUE),][1:10,]
top_ten
```
